title: RaidFix
description: Reducing the cooldown of the Raid Omen to 1.1 seconds to allow most RaidFarm above 40gt to operate.
body:
中文

RaidFix

缩短袭击之兆的cd为 1.1 秒以使大部分 40gt 以上的袭击塔运行并更改不祥之兆的获取方式。

击杀队长后将会直接获得不祥之兆，每多击杀一个队长不祥之兆的等级会+1

运行原理为检测玩家状态效果的变化，当不祥之兆变为袭击之兆后将会移除玩家身上的袭击之兆(30秒cd),并在玩家处召唤半径为0.5,持续时间为2tick的效果云，这将给予玩家1秒(可修改)的袭击之兆效果,以使袭击的cd缩短为1+2tick=1.1秒，因此该数据包不适用于 20gt 的袭击塔。

目前经过测试并完美运行的袭击塔有:

[Tape袭击塔V2](https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV1N94y1z7Pc?t=106.2) ![Tape袭击塔V2](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0e1f7e728443610091151d7a07aed8c3e28b9663.jpeg)
[220k安心挂机袭击农场](https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV1sN4y1s7DW?t=52.1) ![220k安心挂机袭击农场](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/02cbc27b043bc411295a56bffa7bb9495e88c235.jpeg)
English

RaidFix

Reduce the cooldown of the Raid Omen to 1.1 seconds to allow most raid farm above 40 gt to operate and change the way Bad Omen is obtained.

After killing a captain, you will directly obtain Bad Omen, and for each additional captain killed, the level of Bad Omen will increase by 1.

The operation principle is to detect changes in the player's status effects. When Bad Omen turns into Raid Omen (the effect that triggers raids), the Raid Banner effect on the player will be removed (with a 30-second cooldown), and an effect cloud with a radius of 0.5 and a duration of 2 ticks will be summoned at the player's location. This will give the player a 1-second (modifiable) Raid Banner effect, reducing the cooldown of the raid to 1 + 2 ticks = 1.1 seconds. Therefore, this datapack is not suitable for raid farm of 20 gt.

Currently, the raid farm that have been tested and are running perfectly include:

[Tape Raid Tower V2](https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV1N94y1z7Pc?t=106.2) ![Tape袭击塔V2](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0e1f7e728443610091151d7a07aed8c3e28b9663.jpeg)
[220k AFK-Friendly Raid Farm](https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV1sN4y1s7DW?t=52.1) ![220k安心挂机袭击农场](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/02cbc27b043bc411295a56bffa7bb9495e88c235.jpeg)
